newsitem.title: UK: Wlm Cook sets progressive dividend policy.
newsitem.headline: Wlm Cook sets progressive dividend policy.

text.p: Britsh steel castings company William Cook Plc, fighting a hostile takeover bid by engineering group Triplex Lloyd Plc, said on Thursday it had decided to pursue a progressive dividend policy as its earnings grow.
"In future years the board intends to pursue a progressive dividend policy reflecting growth in group earnings," chairman Andrew Cook said in a statement.

A company spokesman said the policy comment, contained in a detailed letter to shareholders, when combined with a 1996/97 full-year profit and dividend forecast made earlier today, ought to encourage Triplex Lloyd to rethink its offer approach.

Anticipating a sharply-worded response from Triplex Lloyd, whose cash and shares bid is currently worth about 309 pence per William Cook share, a Cook spokesman said the firm hoped the predator company would instead opt to recast its bid fundamentally.
"We would hope that Triplex Lloyd moves beyond rhetoric to address the value argument," he told Reuters.
This was not the case, however, as Triplex responded in due course with a caustic statement dubbing the forecast "an implausible short-term reaction to our offer".
